title: review code edits / Choose your review approach
content: ## Choose your review approach You can review agent changes in diffs. Depending on your harness and window, a working set also lets you keep or undo individual changes, files, or all pending edits. Use the table to find the review controls available for your setup. | Setup | Primary review approach | |-------|-------------------------| | {% data variables.product.prodname_copilot_short %} harness in the editor window | [Review pending edits in the working set](#review-pending-edits-with-the-working-set). You can also [compare diffs](#review-changes-by-comparing-diffs). | | Claude or Codex harness in the editor window | [Compare saved changes in diffs](#compare-editor-session-changes). | | {% data variables.copilot.agents_window %} | [Compare diffs in the **Changes** view](#review-changes-in-the-agents-window). | | Cloud session | [Review pull request diffs](#review-sessions-and-cloud-pull-requests). | | Local harness | [Review pending edits](#review-pending-edits-with-the-working-set). See also [Local-specific behavior](#local-harness-specific-behavior). | To check which harness your session uses, see [Identify your current agent harness](/docs/agents/run/agent-harnesses.md#identify-your-current-harness). Agents can change files through editing tools, terminal commands, scripts, and MCP tools. Review the resulting files before you commit or integrate them, including changes that might not appear in a tool-specific list. For keyboard and screen reader access to a diff, use the [Accessible Diff Viewer](/docs/configure/accessibility/accessibility.md#diff-editor-accessibility), which presents changes in a unified patch format.
